name: DarkFlux Quality Overlay
description: Draws resolution (4K/1080p/720p/SD), HDR (DV/HDR10+/HDR10/HLG), best-audio (Atmos/DTS:X/TrueHD/DTS-HD) and community-rating badges onto poster images in memory while they are served - original files are never modified, and every client (Android TV, mobile, web, Infuse, ...) sees the badges. Fork of obxidion's Quality Overlay (GPL-3.0).
overview: Resolution, HDR, audio and rating badges on poster images, rendered in memory.

versions.changelog: Add optional EpisodePosition override (separate badge corner for Episode images) to avoid client overlays.
